decisions.statement: The property a key names is read from the schema the index has.
A key naming a text property is handed to the mechanical change stating one key anew.
A key naming a page type that extends a text property is handed on the same way.
A key naming any other kind of property is refused.
That refusal names the kind of property the key names.
A path the world names no page at is refused.
A key the page's own page type has no property for is refused.
The value under the key is stated anew whole rather than a passage of it.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: the whole value one text property of one page has, stated anew in other words
